name: Konorin
text: Konorin is a pseudo-saint of Brittany whose being comes about twice by magic. Lawless men murder the first Konorin, a plain mortal, by cutting him apart and burning the pieces. Only a strange apple survives him. A young virgin eats that apple and carries a child. Nine months later she bears Saint Konorin, whom tradition calls the child of the apple. The fruit is seen as a token of wisdom.

key_results: Tell how brigands killed the first Konorin.
Name the fruit that renewed him.
State what the apple came to mean.
